answer: A concrete sybil defense: each identity is an island building its own bridge via verifiable epoch-bound work. Clones share no bridge and pay full cost each. A walnut shell wraps every identity, unlocking only with fresh proofs per cycle. An attacker's fleet sends up a plume of activity, but without distinct verified bridges per clone the plume disperses to nothing. The verifier checks that each proof originates from a unique independent source, collapsing clusters sharing infrastructure. Cost scales linearly; weight does not.
